meta.title: Campaign ledger — empty by design
meta.rule: Add timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks and reported orders only when obtained from authorized first-party reports. Keep a dated provenance trail. No conversion score, no revenue forecast, no projected earnings.
meta.why_empty: The only numbers that belong in this table come from the enrolled Associates account's own reports. No such report has been read by any session, so there is nothing to record. A click counter is not a conversion measurement and is never entered here as one.

empty_note: No authorized first-party report has been read, so there are no rows. This is the intended state of the ledger on launch day: an empty table with a defined schema is a measurement plan; a filled table without one is a fabrication.

compliance_checks.check: Disclosure strip present under the masthead on every page, and repeated in the footer
Every outbound link a reader could buy through carries rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"
No price, star rating, review count or stock figure appears anywhere in the built site
Intended identifier and observed redirect target are stored in separate, never-merged fields
Every published table row carries a link to the official source it was read from
Sitemap and feed include every new page on the day it publishes
Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 confirmed enrolled, and this site listed in the account (three flags in src/data/product-intent.json)
Buy buttons publish as reference links until enrolment is confirmed; each becomes a Special Link only after `approved_special_link` is filled in src/data/product-intent.json
Editorial review that no sentence implies endorsement, superiority or hands-on testing
Analytics collector deployed and privacy notice checked against local law before any event is stored
